name: DataPulse Dev Environment
postCreateCommand: cd /workspaces/datapulse/backend && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip -q && pip install -q -r requirements.txt && cd /workspaces/datapulse/frontend && npm install
postStartCommand: cd /workspaces/datapulse/backend && . .venv/bin/activate && echo '=== Starting Mock ES ===' && (python3 backend/scripts/mock_es_server.py --port 9201 &) && sleep 3 && echo '=== Starting Backend API ===' && (ES_URL=http://localhost:9201 uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 &) && sleep 3 && echo '=== Starting Frontend ===' && (cd /workspaces/datapulse/frontend && npm run dev -- --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3000 &) && echo '=== All services started ===' && tail -f /dev/null
